title: Cashless
subtitle: 「無現金的／不用實體現金的／以數碼支付為主」，要分清『不收現金』和『具體使用哪種電子付款』。
description: 「無現金的／不用實體現金的／以數碼支付為主」，要分清『不收現金』和『具體使用哪種電子付款』。

words.meaning: 無現金的；不使用現金的
words.example: The festival is completely cash-free this year.
words.exampleZh: 今年這個節慶完全不使用現金。

exercises.original: The festival is completely cashless this year.
exercises.zh: 今年這個節慶完全不使用現金。
exercises.upgrade: The festival is completely cash-free this year.

options.explanation: 在活動付款語境中，cash-free 和 cashless 幾乎等義，表示不使用實體現金。
只表示不用紙張，例如電子票或電子收據，和是否收現金是不同問題。
活動可以是實體舉行而仍然 cashless；online 不是付款方式同義詞。
自動化系統仍可接受現金，因此不能替代 cashless。
太寬，只說『數碼』，沒有明確表示不收現金。
只是其中一種非現金付款方式，範圍比 cashless 窄。

exercises.original: The museum became cashless after removing its cash tills.
exercises.zh: 博物館移除現金收銀機後改為無現金營運。
exercises.upgrade: The museum became cash-free after removing its cash tills.

options.explanation: 不能單獨表示博物館不收現金。
removing cash tills 直接表明不再處理現金。
博物館可能仍接受插卡，不一定完全 contactless。

exercises.original: The café plans to go cashless next month.
exercises.zh: 咖啡店計劃下月改為無現金付款。
exercises.upgrade: The café plans to go cash-free next month.

options.explanation: 如果咖啡店也接受手機或 QR payment，card-only 會過窄。
go cash-free 是很自然的營運改變表達。
不符實體咖啡店付款狀態。
太寬，不能單獨表達 payment rule。

words.meaning: 不用實體現金；沒有紙幣硬幣
words.example: Passengers can travel without physical cash by using a smart card.
words.exampleZh: 乘客可使用智能卡，在不用實體現金的情況下乘車。

exercises.original: Passengers can travel cashless by using a smart card.
exercises.zh: 乘客可以使用智能卡，在不用實體現金的情況下乘車。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers can travel without physical cash by using a smart card.

options.explanation: smart card 取代紙幣硬幣，直接解釋 cashless。
只涉及紙張／車票，並不表示付款方式。
智能卡仍可代表電子票證，原句重點不是『沒有票』。
付款可能自動，但不是 cashless 的核心意思。
可能是 contactless，但智能卡也不等於所有 cashless 方法。

exercises.original: The store lets customers shop cashless throughout the building.
exercises.zh: 這間店讓顧客全程不用實體現金購物。
exercises.upgrade: The store lets customers shop without physical cash throughout the building.

options.explanation: 直接保留 cashless 的核心：不用紙幣和硬幣。
收據是否存在與付款方式無關。
無人店可以收現金，概念不同。
cashless 反而可能依賴卡付款。
部分電子支付需要網絡，但不是 cashless 的定義。

exercises.original: The event operates cashless, with all purchases made electronically.
exercises.zh: 活動採無現金模式，所有購物都以電子方式付款。
exercises.upgrade: The event operates without physical cash, with all purchases made electronically.

options.explanation: 意思也很接近，但本題目標表達是更簡潔、概括的 without physical cash。
和 electronically 形成清楚對比，語義完整。

words.example: Most purchases were completed using non-cash payment methods.
words.exampleZh: 大部分購物都使用非現金付款方式完成。

exercises.original: Most payments at the venue are cashless transactions.
exercises.zh: 場地大部分付款都是非現金交易。
exercises.upgrade: Most payments at the venue are non-cash transactions.

options.explanation: 在金融／交易分類中，non-cash 正式表示不是以現金結算。
無紙化交易仍可能涉及現金，概念不同。
自動執行不表示不用現金。
cashless 不一定在網上完成。
只是非現金交易的一部分。

exercises.original: The bank encourages cashless payment methods.
exercises.zh: 銀行鼓勵使用非現金付款方式。
exercises.upgrade: The bank encourages non-cash payment methods.

options.explanation: 太廣，不一定和付款有關。
金融語境中是正式、精準分類。

exercises.original: The report tracks the growth of cashless purchases.
exercises.zh: 報告追蹤非現金購物的增長。
exercises.upgrade: The report tracks the growth of non-cash purchases.

options.explanation: 實體店的卡付款也是 cashless，online 過窄。
正式地涵蓋所有非現金付款購物。

words.meaning: 以數碼支付為主；以電子付款為基礎
words.example: The venue uses a digital-payment-based system for all purchases.
words.exampleZh: 場地所有消費都使用以數碼支付為基礎的系統。

exercises.original: The venue is cashless and uses digital payment for every purchase.
exercises.zh: 場地採無現金模式，所有消費都使用數碼支付。
exercises.upgrade: The venue uses a digital-payment-based system for every purchase.

options.explanation: every purchase uses digital payment，這正是 cashless 的實現方式。
場地付款未必需要網上完成。

exercises.original: The transport network has become largely cashless.
exercises.zh: 這個交通網絡現時主要採用數碼支付。
exercises.upgrade: The transport network has become largely digital-payment based.

options.explanation: 可能還接受手機錢包或 QR，因此過窄。
largely 表示支付系統主要依靠數碼方式，而不一定絕對排除所有其他方式。

exercises.original: The market is moving toward a cashless model.
exercises.zh: 市場正轉向以數碼支付為主的模式。
exercises.upgrade: The market is moving toward a digital-payment-based model.

options.explanation: moving toward cashless 正好是以數碼支付作主要付款基礎。

words.meaning: 以電子支付為主；電子付款式的
words.example: The transport network is largely electronic-payment based.
words.exampleZh: 這個交通網絡主要採用電子付款。

exercises.original: The service is cashless and processes all payments electronically.
exercises.zh: 服務採無現金模式，所有付款都以電子方式處理。
exercises.upgrade: The service is electronic-payment based and processes all payments electronically.

options.explanation: all payments electronically 是直接線索。
不代表付款是否用現金。
電子付款也可插卡或網上轉帳，這個說法過窄。
電子付款不一定在線上完成。

exercises.original: The ticketing system is now almost entirely cashless.
exercises.zh: 票務系統現時幾乎完全採用電子付款。
exercises.upgrade: The ticketing system is now almost entirely electronic-payment based.

options.explanation: 售票機可線下現場完成電子付款。
almost entirely cashless 對應以電子付款為主。
電子票證和電子付款是不同維度。

exercises.original: The company replaced most cash handling with a cashless payment system.
exercises.zh: 公司把大部分現金處理改為電子付款系統。
exercises.upgrade: The company replaced most cash handling with an electronic-payment-based system.

options.explanation: replacing cash handling with electronic payments 完全吻合。

words.example: The café is card-only after 6 p.m.
words.exampleZh: 咖啡店下午六時後只接受卡付款。

exercises.original: The café is cashless and accepts only debit and credit cards.
exercises.zh: 咖啡店採無現金模式，只接受扣帳卡和信用卡。
exercises.upgrade: The café is card-only and accepts only debit and credit cards.

options.explanation: accepts only debit and credit cards 是直接定義。
卡也可能插入或刷卡，原句沒有說只限拍卡。
實體咖啡店不是純網上服務。
太廣，無法表達 only cards。

exercises.original: The kiosk is cashless: customers must use a bank card.
exercises.zh: 售貨亭不收現金，顧客必須使用銀行卡。
exercises.upgrade: The kiosk is card-only: customers must use a bank card.

options.explanation: 題目明確要求 bank card，不是手機付款。
must use a bank card 最精準。

exercises.original: The venue went cashless but does not accept mobile wallets.
exercises.zh: 場地改為無現金，但不接受手機錢包，只接受卡付款。
exercises.upgrade: The venue went card-only and does not accept mobile wallets.

options.explanation: 仍可能包括手機錢包，和題目限制不一致。
excludes mobile wallets，明確只剩卡付款。

words.example: The station uses a contactless-payment-based ticketing system.
words.exampleZh: 車站採用以非接觸式付款為主的票務系統。

exercises.original: The station is cashless and passengers tap a card or phone to pay.
exercises.zh: 車站採無現金付款，乘客拍卡或手機付款。
exercises.upgrade: The station uses a contactless-payment-based system.

options.explanation: tap a card or phone 是非接觸式付款的直接特徵。
題目亦接受 phone，因此過窄。

exercises.original: The buses are cashless and use tap-to-pay readers.
exercises.zh: 巴士採無現金付款，使用拍卡付款讀卡器。
exercises.upgrade: The buses use contactless-payment-based fare collection.

options.explanation: tap-to-pay 也可用實體銀行卡。
tap-to-pay readers 是明確 contactless 技術。
票證是否用紙不是付款方式本身。

exercises.original: The shop's cashless checkout works by tapping cards or phones.
exercises.zh: 商店的無現金收銀方式是拍卡或拍手機。
exercises.upgrade: The shop's checkout is contactless-payment based.

options.explanation: tapping cards or phones 正是核心。
因為也接受 phones，所以過窄。

words.meaning: 以手機付款為主；行動支付式的
words.example: The market has become largely mobile-payment based.
words.exampleZh: 這個市場現時主要使用手機付款。

exercises.original: The street market is cashless and most vendors accept QR-code phone payments.
exercises.zh: 街市採無現金模式，大部分攤販接受 QR code 手機付款。
exercises.upgrade: The street market is largely mobile-payment based.

options.explanation: 題目重點是 QR-code phone payments，非卡付款。
大部分付款透過手機完成，最精準。

exercises.original: The service became cashless after introducing app payments.
exercises.zh: 服務引入 app 付款後改為以手機支付為主。
exercises.upgrade: The service became mobile-payment based after introducing app payments.

options.explanation: app payment 未必是 NFC contactless，也可能 QR code。
app payments 是直接手機支付線索。
服務未必只能在線上使用。

exercises.original: Customers at the market now pay cashless mainly through digital wallets.
exercises.zh: 市場顧客現時主要透過數碼錢包無現金付款。
exercises.upgrade: Customers at the market now use a mainly mobile-payment-based system.

options.explanation: 也接近，但 digital wallets 已明確指出 mobile payment，後者更精準。
digital wallet 不等於只用卡。
digital wallets 是典型手機付款。

words.meaning: 只接受數碼付款；純數碼支付
words.example: The event uses digital-only payment at every stall.
words.exampleZh: 活動所有攤位都只接受數碼付款。

exercises.original: The festival is cashless: every stall accepts only digital payment.
exercises.zh: 節慶採無現金模式，每個攤位只接受數碼付款。
exercises.upgrade: The festival uses digital-only payment at every stall.

options.explanation: only digital payment 是直接定義。
數碼支付可能包括手機錢包和 QR code。
現場數碼支付不一定在線上完成。

exercises.original: The new checkout is cashless and does not accept any physical form of money.
exercises.zh: 新收銀方式不接受任何實體現金，只接受數碼付款。
exercises.upgrade: The new checkout is digital-only.

options.explanation: 題目沒有把 digital 限制為卡。
no physical money + cashless 直接支持。

exercises.original: The event moved from cash payment to cashless transactions handled digitally.
exercises.zh: 活動由現金付款轉為純數碼交易。
exercises.upgrade: The event moved to digital-only transactions.

options.explanation: handled digitally + moved away from cash，語義完整。

words.example: The ticket machines are electronic-payment only.
words.exampleZh: 這些售票機只接受電子付款。

exercises.original: The ticket machines are cashless and accept only electronic payment.
exercises.zh: 售票機不收現金，只接受電子付款。
exercises.upgrade: The ticket machines are electronic-payment only.

options.explanation: accept only electronic payment 是直接改寫。
電子付款還可能包括手機等。

exercises.original: The office has a cashless payment rule for all fees.
exercises.zh: 辦事處所有費用都只接受電子付款。
exercises.upgrade: The office has an electronic-payment-only rule for all fees.

options.explanation: cashless payment rule 正式展開為只收電子付款。

exercises.original: The machine is cashless and cannot process notes or coins.
exercises.zh: 機器不處理紙幣或硬幣，只接受電子付款。
exercises.upgrade: The machine is electronic-payment only.

options.explanation: 電子付款可包括插卡，不一定只非接觸式。
cannot process notes or coins，電子付款限定最自然。

words.example: A sign at the entrance says, 'Cash not accepted.'
words.exampleZh: 入口告示寫著「不接受現金」。

exercises.original: The shop is cashless.
exercises.zh: 這間店不接受現金。
exercises.upgrade: The shop operates with a 'cash not accepted' policy.

options.explanation: 直接把 cashless 轉成顧客可理解的付款規則。
會誤解為不用紙張，而不是不用現金。
和常見 cashless payment 方向相反。

exercises.original: A sign says the venue is cashless.
exercises.zh: 告示說場地不接受現金。
exercises.upgrade: A sign says, 'Cash not accepted.'

options.explanation: 如果場地也接受手機付款，這個告示過窄。
是 cashless 最直接、最清楚的告示式表達。

exercises.original: The kiosk is cashless and displays a notice for customers.
exercises.zh: 售貨亭不收現金，並向顧客展示相關告示。
exercises.upgrade: The kiosk displays a notice saying, 'Cash payments not accepted.'

words.example: Customers can pay by card or phone at every counter.
words.exampleZh: 顧客可在每個櫃位以卡或手機付款。

exercises.original: At this cashless venue, customers use cards or phones to pay.
exercises.zh: 在這個無現金場地，顧客以卡或手機付款。
exercises.upgrade: At this venue, customers pay by card or phone.

options.explanation: 直接把 cashless 的實際付款行為說清楚。
語義不清，也不是標準付款類別。
自動付款不等於非現金。
現場卡／手機付款不一定上網。

exercises.original: The bus system is cashless, so passengers use a bank card or mobile wallet.
exercises.zh: 巴士系統無現金化，因此乘客使用銀行卡或手機錢包。
exercises.upgrade: Passengers pay by card or phone on the bus system.

options.explanation: 巴士上拍卡／手機不等於在線付款。
bank card or mobile wallet 被自然概括。

exercises.original: The market is cashless but accepts both cards and mobile wallets.
exercises.zh: 市場不收現金，但接受卡和手機錢包。
exercises.upgrade: At the market, shoppers pay by card or phone.

options.explanation: 題目也接受 mobile wallets，因此太窄。
直接涵蓋兩種主要方式。

words.meaning: 無現金營運；不收現金的營運模式
words.example: The museum moved to cash-free operation last year.
words.exampleZh: 博物館去年改為無現金營運。

exercises.original: The museum became cashless last year.
exercises.zh: 博物館去年改為無現金營運。
exercises.upgrade: The museum moved to cash-free operation last year.

options.explanation: moved to + institution-wide payment change，最自然表達營運模式轉變。

exercises.original: The venue's cashless model reduced the need to handle notes and coins.
exercises.zh: 場地的無現金營運模式減少了處理紙幣和硬幣的需要。
exercises.upgrade: The venue's cash-free operation reduced the need to handle notes and coins.

options.explanation: 太廣，沒有營運層面的 cash handling 意思。
reduced cash handling 是直接線索。

exercises.original: The company plans to make all its stores cashless.
exercises.zh: 公司計劃讓所有店舖改為無現金營運。
exercises.upgrade: The company plans to move all its stores to cash-free operation.

options.explanation: 可能過窄，因為也可接受手機等。
stores 整體營運模式不再處理現金，最完整。

falseSynonyms.zh: 非接觸式不等於所有 cashless contactless 只是一種電子付款技術；插卡、網上轉帳、QR code 等也可以是 cashless。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON All contactless payments are cashless, but not all cashless payments are contactless.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只接受卡付款是 cashless 的子類 card-only 很常見，但若同時接受手機錢包、QR code 或其他電子方式，就比 cashless 窄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A card-only venue is cashless, but a cashless venue may accept more than cards.

falseSynonyms.zh: 網上不等於無現金 online 描述連線／網絡環境；實體商店也可以完全 cashless。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cashless describes payment method, not whether the service is online.

falseSynonyms.zh: 無紙化不等於無現金 paperless 表示不用紙張；cashless 表示不用實體現金。兩者常同時出現，但概念不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A paperless office may still accept cash, and a cashless shop may still print receipts.

falseSynonyms.zh: 非常接近，但要注意絕對程度 cash-free 和 cashless 幾乎同義；然而若場所仍偶爾接受現金，兩者都可能過強。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Use either term carefully when cash remains available as a backup option.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數碼過於寬泛 digital 可以形容資料、服務、裝置或媒體；只有在支付語境中才接近 cashless。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A digital service is not automatically a cashless payment system.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自動化不等於無現金 automatic 表示由系統自動運作；付款仍可能涉及現金。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Automation and cashlessness are separate features.

falseSynonyms.zh: 無現金社會比單一 cashless 場所更廣 cashless society 指整體社會或經濟高度依賴非現金支付；不能用來替代一間商店的 cashless 狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A cashless store is one venue; a cashless society is a much broader social condition.
